letters.letter2: Respected Sir, I request a personal loan of Rs. 2 lakh for my sister's marriage, which I will repay in 24 monthly instalments. I have been working as a store supervisor for the past 4 years with a monthly salary of Rs. 45,000. I am currently paying a bike loan EMI of Rs. 6,000 and have not missed a single payment. Kindly consider my request. Thanking you.
letters.letter3:
To the Loan Officer,
Subject: Application for a personal loan of Rs. 2,00,000

Sir/Madam,
I wish to apply for a personal loan for my sister's wedding. The details are as follows:
1. Loan amount: Rs. 2,00,000
2. Repayment period: 24 months
3. Occupation: Store supervisor, employed for 4 years
4. Monthly salary: Rs. 45,000
5. Existing loan: two-wheeler loan, EMI Rs. 6,000 per month, all payments made on time

I request you to kindly process my application.
Yours faithfully
